evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (guard, inbox, status, install, structure suites; claude plugin test mods/bussin-loop-status 55 pass)

notes:
Did: register.tsx gains typed(text, max) (whitespace runs to one space, control characters stripped via clean, trimmed, capped in code points so an emoji is never split) with TEXT_MAX 500 and NAME_MAX 40, used for plain, done_when, area and the review note in the add, edit and review forms and the 'Add a task to reach it' button; parseMetrics caps names at 40 and keeps at most 10. Drafts go through editable() (drops control characters except newline and tab) in every Input callback. The inbox path (loop path + clock.now() + 12 hex), the screenshot folder check (F3, snapshot.ts toScreenshots) and argv-only sips/open were already in place. New mod test 'typed text is stripped of control characters and capped before it reaches the inbox' (600-character plain and done_when, bell character, 60-character area, 12 metrics of 50+ characters, a control-only edit refused, emoji done_when capped at 500 code points). tests/autoloop-inbox.test.sh gains an odd() loop of 17 awkward changes (empty, whitespace, 500/501 characters, newline, control character, quotes and backslashes, unicode, array, string, {}, unknown op, numeric id, string metric target, 11 metrics, 41-character area), each applied or dropped with a reason, feature_list.json valid on disk and in HEAD after each.
Learned: the engine refuses a whole Pane tree when an Input value holds a control character other than newline or tab, so a single pasted bell or escape character blanked the pane; drafts must be cleaned as they are typed, not only when sent. The review note cap is covered by the same typed() helper but has no test of its own (needs the screenshot fixture).
Lesson: [plugin-authoring] the first mod test run blanked the pane because an Input value held \u0007 → strip control characters (except newline and tab) from every Input draft in its onInput/onSubmit, not just from the value sent.
Lesson: [tests] review found the area cap and done_when/edit caps untested → when a spec lists several caps, assert each one in the test, not just the first.
